note: Pre-registered before any standout code, sim run or fit; tolerances confirmed by the lead as the spec's F1 proposals. Never changed after the first F run. Only Joseph adds known_deviations.

threshold.note: A player is elite for a kind when his card rating (the pool after the league's team-strength shift, before the home-field shift) for the kind's rating is at least this (spec resolved 8).

f1.comparison: In-sample run (scripts/game/calibrate.ts --target insample, 10 leagues x 1,000 games), standouts on vs off, same seeds.
f1.note: Every scrimmage class share (each class of the run and pass families, over all snaps that reach a class draw) within 0.2 percentage points; points per team-game mean within 0.3 points and SD within 0.3 points; turnovers per team-game within 0.05; field goal make rate on tries of 50+ yards within 1 percentage point; no in-sample gated step 5 metric goes from pass to fail.

f2.method: Fixed seed, as step 4 D6: the same slot with a player at the threshold (90) vs a league-average player, all else equal; the boosted class's rate on the plays the kind applies to.
f2.note: Designed (the engineer's choice; the spec sets no number): the boosted class must be at least 10% more likely, relative, with the elite player than with a league-average one. Step 4 D6's 0.02 (data/players/ratings.json minRelativeEffect) is the floor for any rating to count at all; a standout is meant to be visible, so it gets five times that.
